name: @kampus/vitest
description: The new fabrika's test primitives, as Effect keeps its own in @effect/vitest (decision 0538): the test depth, runsFor({ fast, full }), the only reader of FABRIKA_TEST_DEPTH; the Recorder, the one typed way a law watches a service's calls (decision 0579); it, a law's declaration with its plant and label as options, and Plants, their records (decision 0580); and on its own subpath @kampus/vitest/TestDatabase, the one way a test opens a SQLite file.
